_comment_minVersion: Users below this app version are blocked until they update
_comment_forceUpdate: true = block EVERYONE regardless of version. Use with care
_comment_updateUrl: Where the update button sends the user
_comment_updateMessage: Text shown inside the update dialog
updateMessage: من فضلك قم بعمل تحديث للتطبيق لمواصلة استخدام اللتطبيق فقد قمننا بعمل تحسينات مفيدة كتطةير الدروس و الملخصات و اصلاح بض الاخطاء الكتابية
_comment_splashText: Optional line under the loader. Remove this key to hide it
_comment_downloadUrl: Placeholder {fileId} is replaced by the file id. Remove this key to use the original univdocs link
_comment_off: DELETE promoMessage or promoUrl to disable the popup entirely
_comment_promoId: Change this value to start a NEW campaign: resets all counters and the 'never again' choice
promoMessage: هذه رسالة تجريبية 🎉 موقعنا الجديد متاح الآن: دروس، ملخصات، فروض و اختبارات مع قارئ PDF كامل و إمكانية الطباعة.
_comment_promoUrl: REQUIRED. Opened by the visit button in the external browser
_comment_promoButtons: Button labels. Defaults: زيارة الموقع / إغلاق
_comment_promoIntervalHours: Minimum hours between two shows (wall clock). Default 20
_comment_promoMinSessions: Skip users with fewer app launches than this. Default 2
_comment_promoMaxShows: Stop after this many shows. 0 = unlimited
_comment_5: ===== OPTIONAL PROMO KEYS (add only if needed) =====
_comment_promoUsageHours: Real foreground usage hours required since last show. Example 2. Remove to use only promoIntervalHours
_comment_promoImage: Image URL shown inside the popup
_comment_promoDates: promoStartDate / promoEndDate: ISO dates like 2026-05-01 for seasonal campaigns (BEM, exams)
_comment_promoNeverAgain: promoShowNeverAgain false hides the 'لا تظهر مرة أخرى' link. promoNeverAgainText changes its label
_comment_testing: To test now: fresh promoId + promoMinSessions 0 + promoIntervalHours 0, then restore
_comment_cache: Config is cached per app launch, so edits appear on the next cold start
